PMG3: Doubt and duality are burned away by the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
By the Guru's instruction he burns to ashes this doubt that there is another too.
L91N: Within his body, he deals and trades, and obtains the Treasure of the True Name. ||6||
Within his body be trades and traffics and obtains the treasure of the True Name.
0E46: The life-style of the Gurmukh is sublime; he sings the Praises of the Lord.
The Guruward's exalted daily routine is to sing God's praises.
WB55: The Gurmukh finds the gate of salvation.
The true Sikh of the Guru obtains the gate of salvation.
BC0Y: Night and day, he is imbued with the Lord's Love. He sings the Lord's Glorious Praises, and he is called to the Mansion of His Presence. ||7||
Imbued with Lord's love, he, night and day, sings His praises, and is called to His palace.
W72C: The True Guru, the Giver, is met when the Lord leads us to meet Him.
True Guru, the gives, is met when God causes man to meet him.
1JDS: Through perfect destiny, the Shabad is enshrined in the mind.
By perfect destiny, God's Name is enshrined in the man's mind.
GGL1: O Nanak, the greatness of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained by chanting the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||8||9||10||
Nanak, the greatness of God's Name is obtained by chanting the excellences of the True Lord.
A7YQ: Those who lose their own selves obtain everything.
If man loses his ownself, then does he obtain everything.
9ZCM: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, they enshrine Love for the True one.
By the Guru's teaching he comes to cherish true affection for the Lord.
0NHH: They trade in Truth, they gather in Truth, and they deal only in Truth. ||1||
Truth he trades in, truth he amasses and in truthfulness he deals.
093R: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, night and day.
I am devoted, my soul is devoted to those, who ever sing God's praises.
79H5: I am Yours, You are my Lord and Master. You bestow greatness through the Word of Your Shabad. ||1||Pause||
I am Yours you are my Lord. You grantest glory to him who seeks Your Name's shelter. Pause.
P3A8: That time, that moment is totally beautiful,
That time and moment are all beauteous,
1E8W: when the True One becomes pleasing to my mind.
when the True Lord becomes pleasing to my mind.
Q684: Serving the True One, true greatness is obtained. By Guru's Grace, the True One is obtained. ||2||
By serving the True one, true magnificence is obtained, and from the Guru's grace the True Lord is met.
PY39: The food of spiritual love is obtained when the True Guru is pleased.
The food of Divine love is obtained when the True Guru is mightily pleased.
VM09: Other essences are forgotten, when the Lord's Essence comes to dwell in the mind.
One forgets other relishes when he enshrines God's essence in his mind.
A95J: Truth, contentment and intuitive peace and poise are obtained from the Bani, the Word of the Perfect Guru. ||3||
Truthfulness, contentment and eternal peace, the mortal receives from the hymns of the perfect Guru.
AE4E: The blind and ignorant fools do not serve the True Guru;
The ignorant, blind, fools perform not the service of the True Guru.
CVPS: how will they find the gate of salvation?
How will they then obtain the door of deliverance?
VBLX: They die and die, over and over again, only to be reborn, over and over again. They are struck down at Death's Door. ||4||
They repeatedly die and are reborn and again and again they come. At death's door they suffer the strokes.
SCQ5: Those who know the essence of the Shabad, understand their own selves.
If they realise the relish of God's Name, then alone can they under-stand themselves.
4S2F: Immaculate is the speech of those who chant the Word of the Shabad.
Unblemished is the speech of those who recite Gurbani.
XBEH: Serving the True One, they find a lasting peace; they enshrine the nine treasures of the Naam within their minds. ||5||
By serving the True Lord, they attain to the eternal peace and enshrine in their mind the nine treasures of the Lord's Name.
VPCZ: Beautiful is that place, which is pleasing to the Lord's Mind.
Beautiful is that place which is pleasing to God's mind.
ASPA: There, sitting in the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, the Glorious Praises of the Lord are sung.
That alone is the congregation of the saints, seated where-in, one sings God's praises.
V2LU: Night and day, the True One is praised; the Immaculate Sound-current of the Naad resounds there. ||6||
The immaculate heavenly music plays for them who night and day eulogise the True God.

JY91: The wealth of the self-willed manmukhs is false, and false is their ostentatious display.
False is the capital and false the ostentation of apostates.
B2PN: They practice falsehood, and suffer terrible pain.
They practise falsehood and suffer great agony.
UVUU: Deluded by doubt, they wander day and night; through birth and death, they lose their lives. ||7||
Deluded by doubt they wander day and night and lose their life in going and coming.
UL2Y: My True Lord and Master is very dear to me.
The True Lord is exceedingly dear to me.
BZ9J: The Shabad of the Perfect Guru is my Support.
The hymns of the perfect Guru are my main-stay.
V26S: O Nanak, one who obtains the Greatness of the Naam, looks upon pain and pleasure as one and the same. ||8||10||11||
Nanak, they who obtain the greatness of God's Name, deem pain and pleasure alike.
QT5U: The four sources of creation are Yours; the spoken word is Yours.
Yours are the (four) sources of creation and Yours the (four) stages of speech.
ZTE8: Without the Name, all are deluded by doubt.
Without God's Name all are deluded by doubt.
59YM: Serving the Guru, the Lord's Name is obtained. Without the True Guru, no one can receive it. ||1||
From the Guru's service God's Name is obtained. Without the True Guru no one can receive the Lord's Name.
6GMR: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who focus their consciousness on the Lord.
I am a sacrifice, my life is a sacrifice to those who fix their attention with God.
J3DK: Through devotion to the Guru, the True One is found; He comes to abide in the mind, with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||
Through devotion to the Guru. True God is obtained, and He easily comes to abide in the man's mind. Pause.
6BG9: Serving the True Guru, all things are obtained.
If man serves the Sat Guru he then receives everything.
KN2L: As are the desires one harbors, so are the rewards one receives.
As is the aspiration for the sake of which he takes to service, so is the reward, he reaps.
09X1: The True Guru is the Giver of all things; through perfect destiny, He is met. ||2||
The True Guru is the giver of all the things. Through perfect good fortune he is met.
HJE0: This mind is filthy and polluted; it does not meditate on the One.
This filthy mind remembers not the one Lord.
JDVP: Deep within, it is soiled and stained by the love of duality.
It is soiled within immense dust of duality.
V1PV: The egotists may go on pilgrimages to holy rivers, sacred shrines and foreign lands, but they only gather more of the dirt of egotism. ||3||
The egoist repairs to river-banks, shrines, and foreign lands and gathers still more filth of pride.
JL03: Serving the True Guru, filth and pollution are removed.
If he serves the Sat Guru his dirt is removed then.
6QAM: Those who focus their consciousness on the Lord remain dead while yet alive.
One, who fixes his mind on God, remains dead while alive.
G6LB: The True Lord is Pure; no filth sticks to Him. Those who are attached to the True One have their filth washed away. ||4||
Pure is the True Lord, and no filth attaches to Him, He, who gets attached to the Truth, comes to wash off his filth.
W0X4: Without the Guru, there is only pitch darkness.
Without the Guru there is pitch darkness.
PF0U: The ignorant ones are blind-there is only utter darkness for them.
The ignorant man is spiritually blind. For him there is inky darkness.
3FYV: The maggots in manure do filthy deeds, and in filth they rot and putrefy. ||5||
The worms of ordure commit filthy deeds and then putrefy in wickedness.
6F6J: Serving the Lord of Liberation, liberation is achieved.
By waiting upon the Emancipated one is himself emancipated.
0VRU: The Word of the Shabad eradicates egotism and possessiveness.
Through God's Name self-hood and secular love depart.
M402: So serve the Dear True Lord, night and day. By perfect good destiny, the Guru is found. ||6||
Night and day serve the Honourable True Lord. Through perfect good fortune the Guru is obtained.
CB30: He Himself forgives and unites in His Union.
The Lord Himself grants pardon and unites in His union.
5GZN: From the Perfect Guru, the Treasure of the Naam is obtained.
From the perfect Guru man obtains the Name treasure.
XEC1: By the True Name, the mind is made true forever. Serving the True Lord, sorrow is driven out. ||7||
By dwelling on the True Name the soul is sanctified for aye, and by serving the True One sorrow is driven away.
PQN7: He is always close at hand-do not think that He is far away.
The Lord is ever close at hand. Deem Him not distant.
1QP3: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, recognize the Lord deep within your own being.
Under Guru's instruction realise God within you.
08J8: O Nanak, through the Naam, glorious greatness is received. Through the Perfect Guru, the Naam is obtained. ||8||11||12||
Nanak, through God's Name greatness is attained, and from the perfect Guru the Name is received.
9KYE: Those who are True here, are True hereafter as well.
He who is true here, is true hereafter as well.
5KJ5: That mind is true, which is attuned to the True Shabad.
True is the soul that is absorbed in the True Name.
ABDU: They serve the True One, and practice Truth; they earn Truth, and only Truth. ||1||
The True Lord he serves, True Name he repeats and nothing but Truth he practises.
G444: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those whose minds are filled with the True Name.
I am devoted, my soul is devoted to him who places the True Name in his mind.

7ZGQ: The Pandits, the religious scholars read, but they do not taste the essence.
The Pandit reads the religious texts but tastes not their relish.
1GSP: In love with duality and Maya, their minds wander, unfocused.
Owing to duality his mind wanders in worldly valuables.
HLWJ: The love of Maya has displaced all their understanding; making mistakes, they live in regret. ||2||
The love of wealth has ousted his understanding and committing misdeeds he regrets.
RHQ1: But if they should meet the True Guru, then they obtain the essence of reality;
If man meets the True Guru, then does he obtain reality,
52EV: the Name of the Lord comes to dwell in their minds.
and places God's Name in his heart.

9GYC: Those who die in the Shabad and subdue their own minds, obtain the door of liberation. ||3||
He, who dies with God's Name and subdues his mind, obtains the door of emancipation.
PEYA: They erase their sins, and eliminate their anger;
He effaces his sins and annuls his anger,
C0FN: they keep the Guru's Shabad clasped tightly to their hearts.
who keeps Gurbani clasped to his heart.
Y0UC: Those who are attuned to Truth, remain balanced and detached forever. Subduing their egotism, they are united with the Lord. ||4||
They, who are imbued with truth, remain ever detached and stilling their self-hood, they unite their soul with the lord.
2J3H: Deep within the nucleus of the self is the jewel; we receive it only if the Lord inspires us to receive it.
Within the mortal is the Name jewel. It is obtained if the Guru makes it accessible.
6SZD: The mind is bound by the three dispositions-the three modes of Maya.
Otherwise three tempered mind is engrossed in the three qualities of mammon.
TVG1: Reading and reciting, the Pandits, the religious scholars, and the silent sages have grown weary, but they have not found the supreme essence of the fourth state. ||5||
Reading and reciting, the Pandits and silent sages have grown weary, but they know not the worth of fourth state.
B6JC: The Lord Himself dyes us in the color of His Love.
The Lord Himself dyes by importing the dye of His love.

Only those persons, who are imbued with Gurbani, are so dyed.

He, who has adopted the dye of the love of the exceedingly comely Lord, sings God's praises with great relish.

For the Guruward that True One is the wealth, miracle and self-mortification.
8AJ4: Through the spiritual wisdom of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Gurmukh is liberated.
The Guruward acquires Divine knowledge and through God's Name gets emancipated.

The pious person does righteous deeds and is absorbed in the Truest of the true.

The True Guru-Sikh realises that the Lord creates and having created Himself destroy.
JN07: To the Gurmukh, the Lord Himself is social class, status and all honor.
Of the Guruward the Lord Himself is the caste and all honour.

Nanak, the Sikh resigned to the Guru's will meditates on the Name and merges in the Name of the Name-incarnate Lord.

The creation and deluge occur through the Lord's Word.
MHLZ: Through the Shabad, creation happens again.
Through the Word the creation evolves again.

EAC9: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Perfect Guru within their minds.
I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice to those who enshrine the perfect Guru in their mind.

2AJN: The Gurmukh sees Him in wind and fire; such is the wonder of His Play.
Guru's beloved realises Him playing wonderous games through wind and fire.

NC1H: The One Creator has set this play in motion.
That Creator has set a play in motion.
PMJR: In the frame of the human body, He has placed all things.
In the frame work of the human body He has put all the goods.
U1CD: Those few who are pierced through by the Word of the Shabad, obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. He calls them into His Wondrous Palace. ||3||
Pierced through with His Name, some rare person obtains the Lord's presence. Such a bride the Master calls into His mansion.
8YNT: True is the Banker, and true are His traders.
True is the Banker, and true are His traders.
S2TC: They purchase Truth, with infinite love for the Guru.
Through infinite love of the Guru they purchase the True Name.
0UHD: They deal in Truth, and they practice Truth. They earn Truth, and only Truth. ||4||
Truth they deal in, truth they practise and nothing but Truth they earn.
TG1L: Without investment capital, how can anyone acquire merchandise?
How can any one have merchandise without the capital?
CT89: The self-willed manmukhs have all gone astray.
The wayward persons are all gone astray.
22MN: Without true wealth, everyone goes empty-handed; going empty-handed, they suffer in pain. ||5||
Without the Name's wealth all go empty-handed, and going empty-handed, they suffer pain.
JDXL: Some deal in Truth, through love of the Guru's Shabad.
Some deal in the True Name through the love of Gurbani.
XAMA: They save themselves, and save all their ancestors as well.
They save themselves and save their entire lineage as wall.
1XWE: Very auspicious is the coming of those who meet their Beloved and find peace. ||6||
Acceptable is the advent of those who meeting their Beloved obtain peace.
LPMS: Deep within the self is the secret, but the fool looks for it outside.
Just within is the thing but the fool searches for it without.
NS1D: The blind self-willed manmukhs wander around like demons;
The blind apostates roam about like demons.
L89P: but where the secret is, there, they do not find it. The manmukhs are deluded by doubt. ||7||
Where there is the thing, from there none obtains it. The way-wards are gone amiss in doubt.
A8QM: He Himself calls us, and bestows the Word of the Shabad.
The Lord Himself summons and bestows His Name.
FPSK: The soul-bride finds intuitive peace and poise in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
The bride attains to eternal peace in her Groom's mansion.
BTR7: O Nanak, she obtains the glorious greatness of the Naam; she hears it again and again, and she meditates on it. ||8||13||14||
Nanak, he, who himself continually hears and remembers God's Name, obtains the glory of the Name.
K8H0: The True Guru has imparted the True Teachings.
The True Guru has given the True piece of advice.

ZJ6K: Think of the Lord, who shall be your Help and Support in the end.
Meditate on God who will be your succourer at the end.

The inaccessible, incomprehensible and unborn Lord in without a master. Through the love of the True Guru. He is obtained.
LAWK: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who eliminate selfishness and conceit.
I am devoted, my life is devoted to him who casts away his self-conceit.

If the mortal effaces his ego, then does he obtain God and gets easily merged with the Lord. Pause.
SDJH: According to their pre-ordained destiny, they act out their karma.
I have done the deed which was pre-ordained for me.
RFS8: Serving the True Guru, a lasting peace is found.
By rendering service to the True Guru I have procured the eternal peace.
JF1H: Without good fortune, the Guru is not found. Through the Word of the Shabad, they are united in the Lord's Union. ||2||
Without good destiny, one finds not the Guru, Through His Name the Lord unites him in His union.
84HC: The Gurmukhs remain unaffected in the midst of the world.
The Guruward remains unaffected in this world.
TH2T: The Guru is their cushion, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is their Support.
He has the support of the Guru and the main-stay of the Name.
2UAD: Who can oppress the Gurmukh? One who tries shall perish, writhing in pain. ||3||
Who can play aggressive with him, the Guru's True Sikh? The aggressor automatically perishes and writhes in pain.
DXY7: The blind self-willed manmukhs have no understanding at all.
The blind apostate has no understanding.
5BGP: They are the assassins of the self, and the butchers of the world.
He is the self-killer and the world-butcher.
5G1W: By continually slandering others, they carry a terrible load, and they carry the loads of others for nothing. ||4||
By continually slandering others he carries a great load. Without wages he carries other's load.
W7P4: This world is a garden, and my Lord God is the Gardener.
This World is a garden and my Lord is its Gardener.
5T3L: He always takes care of it-nothing is exempt from His Care.
He ever takes care of it. No part of it is exempt from His care.
QHZD: As is the fragrance which He bestows, so is the fragrant flower known. ||5||
As is the odour which the Lord infuses into the flower so does it prevail there-in. The fragrant flower is known by its fragrance.
HSNR: The self-willed manmukhs are sick and diseased in the world.
The perverse is disease-stricken in this world.
A92P: They have forgotten the Giver of peace, the Unfathomable, the Infinite.
He has forgotten the inaccessible, and illimitable Lord, the giver of peace.
VZVS: These miserable people wander endlessly, crying out in pain; without the Guru, they find no peace. ||6||
The miserable ever wander lamenting. Without the Guru they obtain not peace.
U8BM: The One who created them, knows their condition.
He, who created them, knows their condition.
37E0: And if He inspires them, then they realize the Hukam of His Command.
If the Lord Himself shows mercy, then, man realises His command.
F9CM: Whatever He places within them, that is what prevails, and so they outwardly appear. ||7||
As is the disposition God puts in the mortal so does he behave. The Lord Himself is potent to rot out such disposition.
CJWR: I know of no other except the True One.
Without that True Lord, I recognise not any other.
CK0X: Those, whom the Lord attaches to Himself, become pure.
He whom he attaches with Himself, becomes pure.

Nanak, the Lord's Name abides within his mind. He, to whom the Lord donates His Name, attains to it.
8REA: Enshrining the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, in the mind,
By enshrining in the heart the Nectarean name of God,
8B09: all the pains of egotism, selfishness and conceit are eliminated.
all the pain of egotism and egoism is eliminated.
L8HM: By continually praising the Ambrosial Bani of the Word, I obtain the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||
By ever praising the ambrosial Gurbani the man obtains immortalising Name-Nectar.
KQQJ: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Ambrosial Bani of the Word within their minds.
I am dedicated, my life is dedicated to those who place in their mind the regenerating hymns of the Guru.
BZ1P: Enshrining the Ambrosial Bani in their minds, they meditate on the Ambrosial Naam. ||1||Pause||
He, who enshrines in his heart the immortalising Gurbani, begins to meditate on the Nectarean Name. Pause.
91ZB: Those who continually chant the Ambrosial Words of Nectar,
Those who continually utter the Nectar-Name with mouth,
MU9D: See and behold this Amrit everywhere with their eyes.
always see and assay this Amrit everywhere with their eyes.
PFQ0: They continually chant the Ambrosial Sermon day and night; chanting it, they cause others to hear it. ||2||
The Nectar discourse of the Lord he ever utters day and night, and repeating it makes others hear.
HWXT: Imbued with the Ambrosial Love of the Lord, they lovingly focus their attention on Him.
Imbued with the ambrosial love of the Lord he fixes his attention on Him.
3R83: By Guru's Grace, they receive this Amrit.
The Nectar (Name) he receives by the Guru's grace.
V9ZH: They chant the Ambrosial Name with their tongues day and night; their minds and bodies are satisfied by this Amrit. ||3||
The elixir (Name) day and night he repeats with his tongue, and his soul and body are satiated. with the elixir (Name)

God does that what is not even in the man's specter.
E7CF: no one can erase the Hukam of His Command.
His flat no one can undo.

By his sweet will the Nectarean Gurbani has become prevalent, and by his will one quaffs the Nectarean Gurbani.
1ZQZ: The actions of the Creator Lord are marvellous and wonderful.
Wonderful are the doings of God, the Creator.
6BC0: This mind is deluded, and goes around the wheel of reincarnation.
This mistaken mind goes round in the circuit of transmigration.
GRQ9: Those who focus their consciousness on the Ambrosial Bani of the Word, hear the vibrations of the Ambrosial Word of the Shabad. ||5||
Who focuses his mind on the ambrosial Gurbani, for him is played the music of the Nectarean Name.

BP5F: You Yourself created the counterfeit and the genuine.
The counterfeit and the genuine. You Yourself have created.
KSHM: You Yourself assays all the mortals.
QZXN: You appraise the true, and place them in Your Treasury; You consign the false to wander in delusion. ||6||
Having assayed the true You consigns to Yours treasury and the false You misleadest in doubt.
CUZ6: How can I behold You? How can I praise You?
How should I behold and how eulogise You?
3S4D: By Guru's Grace, I praise You through the Word of the Shabad.
By the Guru's favour through Gurbani I praise You, O Lord!

In Yours will the Nectar abides and in Your will You makest man quaff the Nectar.

By serving the True Guru, Gurbani gets permeated in the mind.

Nanak the Name Nectar is ever the peace-giver. By drinking the Name Nectar all the hunger is satiated.
6BF4: The Ambrosial Nectar rains down, softly and gently.
The Name-Nectar rains in the natural way.
7DP6: How rare are those Gurmukhs who find it.
Some rare pious person receives it.

I am a sacrifices, my life is a sacrifice to the pious persons who make others drink the Name-Nectar.
QKJ1: The tongue tastes the essence, and remains forever imbued with the Lord's Love, intuitively singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

By the Guru's grace some solitary mortal obtains Divine comprehension,

and stilling his duality contracts love with the one Lord.

8MPJ: Above all is Your Glance of Grace, O God.
Over all is Yours grace, O my Lord!
70G5: Upon some it is bestowed less, and upon others it is bestowed more.
On some it is more and on some less.
2FU8: Without You, nothing happens at all; the Gurmukhs understand this. ||3||
Without You nothing does happen The Sikhs resigned to the Guru's will achieve this understanding.
D7JQ: The Gurmukhs contemplate the essence of reality;
The Guruwards ponder over this reality that,

Yours treasures are brimful with Nectar.
2AWP: Without serving the True Guru, no one obtains it. It is obtained only by Guru's Grace. ||4||
Without serving the True Guru none receives the Name Nectar. By the Guru's grace it is procured.
80QL: Those who serve the True Guru are beautiful.
The person, who serves the Sat Guru, is beauteous.
EFAN: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, entices their inner minds.
The Name-Nectar has charmed his inner mind.
ELUS: Their minds and bodies are attuned to the Ambrosial Bani of the Word; this Ambrosial Nectar is intuitively heard. ||5||
With the ambrosial Gurbani his soul and body are tinged and the ambrosial Gurbani he instinctively hear.
C34Z: The deluded, self-willed manmukhs are ruined through the love of duality.
The misled apostate is ruined through secular love.
PGPR: They do not chant the Naam, and they die, eating poison.
The Name, he utters not and dies by taking poison.
Y64X: Night and day, they continually sit in manure. Without selfless service, their lives are wasted away. ||6||
Night and day his abode is ever in ordure. Without the Lord's service he wastes awry his life.
UEXX: They alone drink in this Amrit, whom the Lord Himself inspires to do so.
He, whom the Lord Himself causes to drink, quaffs the Name Nectar.
G6QJ: By Guru's Grace, they intuitively enshrine love for the Lord.
By the Guru's grace he enshrines affection for the Lord.
F20G: The Perfect Lord is Himself perfectly pervading everywhere; through the Guru's Teachings, He is perceived. ||7||
The perfect Lord is Himself fully-pervading everywhere. Under Guru's instruction. He is discerned.
4TZJ: He Himself is the Immaculate Lord.
That immaculate Lord is all by Himself.
ZEZP: He who has created, shall Himself destroy.
Who created the universe, He Himself shall destroy it.
1E14: O Nanak, remember the Naam forever, and you shall merge into the True One with intuitive ease. ||8||16||17||
Nanak, do you ever remember God's Name Thus shall you be easily blended with the True One.
1TSY: Those who please You are linked to the Truth.
They, whom You likest, adhere to Truth.
YUB3: They serve the True One forever, with intuitive ease.
Ever they serve True Lord in the natural way.
2C9Y: Through the True Word of the Shabad, they praise the True One, and they merge in the merging of Truth. ||1||
Through the True Gurbani they eulogise the True One and meet the society of the righteous.
JH4Z: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who praise the True One.
I am devoted, my soul is devoted to those who chant the glory of the True Master.
LZ3W: Those who meditate on the True One are attuned to Truth; they are absorbed into the Truest of the True. ||1||Pause||
They, who meditate on the True Being are imbued with Truth and get absorbed in the Truest of the true. Pause.
JPPA: The True One is everywhere, wherever I look.
Wherever I behold, I find the True Lord at all the places.
G9TN: By Guru's Grace, I enshrine Him in my mind.
By the Guru's grace enshrine Him in my heart.
1AHD: True are the bodies of those whose tongues are attuned to Truth. They hear the Truth, and speak it with their mouths. ||2||
True is the body of the man whose tongue is tinged with Truth, who hears and with his mouth utters truth.

GATQ: Subduing their desires, they merge with the True One;
Stilling her desire the bride blends with her True Spouse,
WCGB: they see in their minds that everyone comes and goes in reincarnation.
and with her mind she sees everyone, subject to coming and going.
CJJ5: Serving the True Guru, they become stable forever, and they obtain their dwelling in the home of the self. ||3||
By serving the True Guru the mortal becomes stable for ever, and secures dwelling in his own home.
9SS1: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, the Lord is seen within one's own heart.
By the Guru's instruction I have perceived the Lord within my mind.
T2NH: Through the Shabad, I have burned my emotional attachment to Maya.
The love of worldly valuables, I have burnt with the God's Name
PQE9: I gaze upon the Truest of the True, and I praise Him. Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I obtain the True One. ||4||
The Truest of the true I behold and admire By the Guru's instruction I obtain the True Lord.
AV8K: Those who are attuned to Truth are blessed with the Love of the True One.
They who are tinged with truth, are blessed with the true love of the Lord.
S2UB: Those who praise the Lord's Name are very fortunate.
They, who remember the Name of God, are very fortunate.
WADC: Through the Word of His Shabad, the True One blends with Himself, those who join the True Congregation and sing the Glorious Praises of the True One. ||5||
The True Lord blends with Himself those, who by joining the saints' congregation, sing His true praises.
EVH5: We could read the account of the Lord, if He were in any account.
We may read the Lord's account if He were within any account.
H4RZ: He is Inaccessible and Incomprehensible; through the Shabad, understanding is obtained.
He is beyond reach and above comprehension. Through the Guru's instruction His knowledge is received.
BSCQ: Night and day, praise the True Word of the Shabad. There is no other way to know His Worth. ||6||
Night and day praise the True Lord. There is no other way to know His worth.
5LWN: People read and recite until they grow weary, but they do not find peace.
By reading and reciting men grow weary but they obtain not peace.
J5BT: Consumed by desire, they have no understanding at all.
By desire they are consumed, and they have no knowledge of it.
7HT7: They purchase poison, and they are thirsty with their fascination for poison. Telling lies, they eat poison. ||7||
Poison they purchase and for the love of poison they are thirsty. By telling lies they eat poison.
7AW3: By Guru's Grace, I know the One.
Through Guru's grace I know but One God.
R2BR: Subduing my sense of duality, my mind is absorbed into the True One.
Killing duality my soul is absorbed in the True Lord.
Y81F: O Nanak, the One Name is pervading deep within my mind; by Guru's Grace, I receive it. ||8||17||18||
Nanak, the One Name alone is prevailing within my mind. By the Guru's grace is the Name received.
N3U6: In all colors and forms, You are pervading.
All the castes and forms are made prevalent by You.
RVNE: People die over and over again; they are re-born, and make their rounds on the wheel of reincarnation.
Men repeatedly die are reborn and go round in many circuits.
F9FX: You alone are Eternal and Unchanging, Inaccessible and Infinite. Through the Guru's Teachings, understanding is imparted. ||1||
You alone are unshakable, un-knowable and unlimited. By the Guru's teachings is Yours understanding imparted.
2MWV: I am a sacrifice, my soul is a sacrifice, to those who enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds.
I am a sacrifice, my life is a sacrifice to those who enshrine the Name of the pervading God in their mind.
JF4S: The Lord has no form, features or color. Through the Guru's Teachings, He inspires us to understand Him. ||1||Pause||
He has no features, marks and colour By the Guru's instruction He causes Himself to be under-stood. Pause.
GR62: The One Light is all-pervading; only a few know this.
Among all is the light of the One Lord, if some mortal were to realise it.
L44R: Serving the True Guru, this is revealed.
By serving the True Guru it becomes manifest.
UMZG: In the hidden and in the obvious, He is pervading all places. Our light merges into the Light. ||2||
In all the non-apparent and apparent places He is diffused. In the Supreme Light the man's light ultimately merges.
HFKC: The world is burning in the fire of desire,
Man is burning in the fire of desire,
EWSS: in greed, arrogance and excessive ego.
and is lost in darkness due to arrogance and excessive egotism.
UC45: People die over and over again; they are re-born, and lose their honor. They waste away their lives in vain. ||3||
He repeatedly goes, comes and loses his honour. His life he wastes away in vain.
BSHE: Those who understand the Word of the Guru's Shabad are very rare.
Rare is the person who under-stands Gurbani.
KF3C: Those who subdue their egotism, come to know the three worlds.
When man effaces his self-conceit, then does he come to acquire the knowledge of the three worlds.
NBLY: Then, they die, never to die again. They are intuitively absorbed in the True One. ||4||
Then he remains dead in life and dies not again. He rather easily blends with the true Lord.
YF2R: They do not focus their consciousness on Maya again.
He fixes not his mind then in worldly valuables,
AH6P: They remain absorbed forever in the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Who remains absorbed in the Guru's hymns for ever.
KX7E: They praise the True One, who is contained deep within all hearts. They are blessed and exalted by the Truest of the True. ||5||
He eulogises the True Lord who is contained in all the hearts, and in All-truth he looks beautiful.
VBKK: Praise the True One, who is Ever-present.
I praise the True One who is ever present,
G8CE: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is pervading everywhere.
and who's mind is filled with the Guru's hymns.
U37Q: By Guru's Grace, we come to behold the True One; from the True One, peace is obtained. ||6||
Through the Guru's grace the True Master is beheld, and from the True Being one gathers solace.
6PAC: The True One permeates and pervades the mind within.
The True Lord remains permeated in the mind.
LSS4: The True One is Eternal and Unchanging; He does not come and go in reincarnation.
The True One is ever permanent He comes and goes not.
QB08: Those who are attached to the True One are immaculate and pure. Through the Guru's Teachings, they merge in the True One. ||7||
The man, who gets attached with the True Master is pure. By the Guru's teaching he blends with the True One.
D66G: Praise the True One, and no other.
I praise the True One and naught else.
S96X: Serving Him, eternal peace is obtained.
By serving whom eternal peace is obtained.
